name: shopline-dashboard
description: Shop Ops - a locally hosted, editable dashboard for shops. Schedules drop-off and pickup appointments by unit and equipment type, tracks weapons by type, keeps the shop notes board, and streams live to a kiosk wall display. Zero npm dependencies.

scripts.reset: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>{try{fs.rmSync('data/db.json')}catch{};console.log('Database reset. It will be re-seeded on next start.')})"
